name: bunkr
description: Universal glassmorphic attendance tracker, 75% bunk budget calculator, and real-time smart timetable for college & university students

scripts.prep: cp timetable.html deploy/app.html && cp timetable.html boot/app.html
scripts.sync: npm run prep && npx cap sync
scripts.open: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.build: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
